definitions.explanation: The practice of writing characters neatly, especially with brush and ink as taught in Japanese schools.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}で{習字|しゅうじ}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned penmanship in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {習字|しゅうじ}の{時間|じかん}は{好|す}きだった。
{娘|むすめ}を{習字|しゅうじ}{教室|きょうしつ}に{通|かよ}わせている。
examples.english: I have my daughter attend calligraphy class.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
・{書道|しょどう} - calligraphy as an art form, more formal/artistic
・{習字|しゅうじ} - penmanship, learning to write properly (school subject)

{習字|しゅうじ} focuses on learning proper character formation, while {書道|しょどう} emphasizes artistic expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{習字|しゅうじ}を{習|なら}う (to learn penmanship)
・{習字|しゅうじ}{教室|きょうしつ} (penmanship/calligraphy class)
・{習字|しゅうじ}{道具|どうぐ} (calligraphy tools)
・{習字|しゅうじ}セット (calligraphy set)

[Register: Neutral]
